name: Gmina Leśna (Poland)
description: Three diagonal stripes of blue, red and green rising from the lower hoist to the upper fly on a flag with a rounded fly end.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: three diagonal stripes rising towards the fly
